instruction:
Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\class_ab.cir` in native PSpice. Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`. At the start of the task, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.

Keep the generated `C:\Users\user\Desktop\class_ab.out` and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\class_ab_measure.txt` files, then inspect the native DC transfer measurements and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\xover.json` near zero volts input. Report `Vout_at_-20mV`, `Vout_at_-10mV`, `Vout_at_0mV`, `Vout_at_10mV`, `Vout_at_20mV`, `dead_zone_mV`, and `crosses_zero_symmetrically`. Set `dead_zone_mV` to 20.0 when both `|VOUT_N10M|` and `|VOUT_P10M|` are below 0.05 V, otherwise set it to 0.0. Set `crosses_zero_symmetrically` to true exactly when `|VOUT_N20M + VOUT_P20M| < 0.2` V.
